Return approved drugs (max_phase_for_ind = 4) associated with infection-related indications. Extract ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, indication EFO ID (as indication_curie), indication label (as indication_label), and max_phase_for_ind. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures and drug_indication. Filter drug_indication where mesh_heading contains 'infection' (case-insensitive). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
